title: Great for privacy
text: Great for privacy. Easy to install, hard to see thru. Just what I wanted.

product_metadata.title: Haton Window Privacy Film, Frosted Glass Window Film, Static Cling UV Blocking Removable Window Clings, Opaque Window Stickers, Vinyl Window Coverings for Home Office, Non Adhesive 35.4×157.4 Inches
features: Classic And Ingenious Design: This window film features the classic frosted texture and decent patterns, brings brand-new design sense for your domestic adornment and makes your home style in a modern way. It is the perfect substitute of curtain and shutter on adornment performance

UV Rejection, Eye Protection: While blocking 84% UVA rays and 99% UVB rays for you and your family, it filters out the glare and let soft lights in so as to protect your eyes. It can protect your skin from harmful radiation exposure and the discoloration of furniture can also be prevented

No Glue Hassle, Easy Installation: With non-adhesive and static cling design, this window vinyl avoids the release of chemical substances and can be removed easily without any traces left on a glass. You can reuse if it is not damaged or smudged. Remember to peel off the film backing and spray enough water

Extensive Use For Various Space: This product is perfect for adding a decorative and functional cover to smooth glass surfaces without dust or oil. Widely suitable for different places: kitchen, living room, dining room, office, hotels, classroom, lobby, etc.

No Disturbing Eyes From Neighbors: No more peeps, it blurs view and provides peaceful and relaxing space for your kids, pets and family. The privacy level is semi-privacy: 60%, which is not recommended for high privacy needed places like bathroom
